0022600150.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-5, 15th in the West, 0-3 on the road) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (5-0, first in the West and first in the Southwest) in the Kings' sixth game of the season, with Sacramento on a five-game losing streak and Memphis on a five-game winning streak. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), all listed as out, while Memphis has Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Ty Jerome (back soreness) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. Sacramento trails 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 123-112 loss in Sacramento on October 25, and the Kings lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
